description_expanded: **Must be at least 25 years of age to rent this property. Summer's Edge, 33 Ryan Street at Seagrove Beach - 30a Brought to you by Beach Blue Properties. "33 Palms" is the perfect beach house. Located just next to the pool and beach, down a peaceful lane in Seagrove Beach just off 30a. Our staff gives it 5 stars! Meticulously renovated and updated by interior designer Kristie Barnett, this home, in the popular Summers Edge community, offers 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and sleeps up to 10 guests. On the beachside of 30a, our beach house is situated next to the swimming pool on the coveted, bike-friendly South Ryan cul-de-sac. Just 20 steps to one of two luxurious community pools, and 65 yards to the beach – there are no busy streets to cross! Seagrove Beach is within biking distance to Seaside, and a few miles from picturesque Rosemary Beach, Seacrest Beach and Alys Beach. The HOA does not allow golf carts. 33 Palms boasts a total of four outdoor sitting areas – a front porch, two covered balconies, plus a large sundeck off the third floor. Newly refinished hardwood floors flow throughout all three levels of this elegant home. With three king bedroom suites and two separate bunk areas for up to 4 children, this home comfortably sleeps 10 guests. The entrance to this home begins at the front porch with a classic swing. Just inside, the living area is furnished with a designer combination of new and vintage décor complete with comfortable seating and a 60” smart television. In the statement kitchen you’ll find stainless steel appliances, Cambria quartz countertops, a lovely tiled back splash, and open shelving. The contemporary oval dining table seats 6, and the adjacent kitchen counter bar seats 3. There is an outdoor propane grill and a heated outdoor shower for your convenience. The light-filled first floor bedroom features a KING bed, 35” Smart TV, an attached renovated bath, and a closet just big enough to tuck in a pack-n-play for baby’s naptime. This provides a perfect option for guests who would prefer the convenience of never having to climb stairs during their stay. The main master suite is found on the second floor, and is the perfect hideaway outfitted with a KING upholstered bed, a 60” mounted smart TV, and a relaxing upholstered chaise lounge for afternoon reading or checking emails. The master bath includes a double vanity, a walk-in frameless glass shower, and a soaking tub. Step out onto the private balcony overlooking the entrance to the pool, and enjoy your morning coffee. The second master suite is outfitted with a KING bed, a 35” Smart TV, and a bathroom with a walk-in glass shower. The hallway bunk area sleeps 2 children, and provides a dresser along with luggage storage beneath the twin built-in bunks. Please note: All Televisions are SMART only, and you will need to log in to your own streaming accounts. Bunk areas on different floors are great for separating the boys from the girls. The 3rd floor loft bedroom is a perfect getaway for 2 guests with twin bunks, a 35” SmartTV with Wii (bring your own streaming device for more options), and a large sun deck. The upstairs bunk area does not provide cable service for the television, rather, it is a perfect for dvd movies or wii gaming. 33 Palms is the ideal spot for your family vacation, friends weekend, couples getaway, or special event! CANCELLATION: Reservations that are cancelled more than 30 days prior to the arrival date receive a full refund. Reservations cancelled 14-29 days prior to arrival receive a refund of 50% of the amount paid. Reservations cancelled within 14 days of arrival receive no refund unless the guest purchased travel insurance. Guests are required to complete a rental agreement by electronic signature within 3 days of booking. NOTE: The total reservation cost includes the nightly rate, clean fee, damage waiver, processing fee and tax. By requesting a quote for this property, you agree to be added to our email subscription list.
